Meme Kombat (MK) merges web3 gaming with meme culture, enabling users to earn staking rewards through battles. Scotty the AI ($SCOTTY) integrates AI and blockchain to enhance security and fraud detection, gaining traction for its community-first model. Sponge V2 offers four years of staking rewards in V2 tokens for users who stake and lock V1 tokens. eTukTuk (TUK) focuses on expanding electric vehicle charging infrastructure in developing nations, offering a 211% APY during its presale. Poodl Inu, a dog-themed meme coin, provides staking rewards through a multi-stage presale with increasing prices. Cerra operates on the Cardano blockchain as a DeFi platform, allowing CERRA token holders to earn profit shares via staking, with a minimum purchase of 500 ADA at $0.2 per token. The article underscores that crypto presales are critical for funding development and enabling early access at discounted rates, but cautions investors to exercise due diligence due to the volatile nature of cryptocurrencies and geographical constraints.

articles.title: Analyst: AI Will Make Stocks Obsolete, Driving Investors to Bitcoin
articles.summary: Jordi Visser, an analyst and investor, argues that artificial intelligence will accelerate innovation cycles to weeks, rendering public companies ineffective investment vehicles and positioning Bitcoin as a superior long‑term asset. He told Anthony Pompliano: 'Si el ciclo de innovación se acelera ahora a semanas, estamos en un videojuego donde tu empresa nunca alcanza la velocidad de escape, y en ese mundo, ¿cómo inviertes? No inviertes, haces trading'. Visser also said: 'Bitcoin es una creencia. Las creencias duran más que las ideas. No hay empresas en el S&P 500 que existieran en el 100 a.C.; el oro ha existido desde entonces. Bitcoin existirá por mucho, mucho tiempo. Es una creencia en este punto, y la gente puede luchar contra ella, pero va a perdurar'. He added that AI could compress what would normally take 100 years into five years. The article notes Bitcoin’s market capitalization exceeds $2.1 trillion and that some analysts predict it will surpass gold’s market cap in the coming decades. Eric Trump also forecasted Bitcoin would reach $1 million per coin at the Bitcoin Asia 2025 conference in Hong Kong. The piece highlights that companies are buying Bitcoin directly as treasury reserves, diverting capital from traditional equity markets to digital finance. These claims are presented as facts, reflecting a bias toward Bitcoin’s long‑term dominance.

articles.title: LATAM Crypto News: Bitso Expands with Stablecoin Payment Solutions as El Dorado Enters Bolivia
articles.summary: Bitso Business, the B2B arm of Mexican crypto exchange Bitso, concluded its 2025 Stablecoin Conference with major announcements, including entry into Chile and Peru and launch of two stablecoin‑driven corporate payment systems. The event drew over 1,800 participants from 43 countries, more than half of whom were founders, leaders or directors from over 800 organisations. Key features highlighted were FXaaS (Foreign Exchange as a Service), allowing institutional clients to embed currency services directly into their platforms, and Pay with Bitso, a crypto‑payment solution enabling merchants to accept digital assets with fast fiat or stablecoin settlement. In parallel, Argentina’s National Securities Commission (CNV) approved General Resolution No. 1081, extending the country’s tokenisation regime to include listed equities, corporate bonds and CEDEARs, thereby positioning Argentina at the forefront of regulatory innovation in Latin America. Finally, El Dorado, a Latin‑American peer‑to‑peer stablecoin‑payment app, announced its formal launch in Bolivia, aiming to boost stablecoin adoption amid dollar shortages and promote financial inclusion. The app, already available in Argentina, Brazil, Colombia, Panama, Paraguay and Peru, allows users to buy and sell USDT in bolivianos via more than 70 payment methods such as Yape, Mercado Pago, Pix and bank transfers. In its first year, El Dorado had over 200,000 users and one million transactions, and it plans to become a “SuperApp” for stablecoin payments in Latin America by the end of 2025.

articles.title: Has Bitcoin's Bull Cycle Ended? Understanding the Scenario for the Market's Leading Cryptocurrency
articles.summary: Bitcoin reached a historic peak of US$124,500 in August, but the cryptocurrency has since entered a correction phase, leaving investors uncertain. Luis Kuniyoshi, a cryptocurrency specialist at Empiricus, argues that the bull cycle has not ended, citing two key factors: (1) global stock markets are recovering, and (2) the macro‑economic environment is becoming favorable for digital assets. He explains that the Russell 2000 index, which tracks small‑cap stocks that perform well when risk appetite and liquidity are high, is a positive sign for cryptocurrencies, stating, 'O Russell 2000 é o índice que contempla ações pequenas, que costumam performar muito bem quando o apetite por risco está muito alto, ou seja, quando temos muita liquidez no sistema. Inclusive, é o mesmo ambiente onde criptomoedas performam muito bem.' Kuniyoshi also notes that the macro‑economic outlook suggests the current dip is likely a short‑term correction rather than a long‑term reversal. The article, updated on 29 August 2025, presents these viewpoints without overt bias, offering a balanced explanation of the market dynamics.
